All six Kiro findings from REVIEW-r3 (native tool-name matcher, session-id fallback, KIRO_API_KEY rule clash, release channel, project-source default, stdout format) are still present verbatim in the current docs with no owner ruling. This is a pure doc gap re-verified now, not a re-finding of the same text.

findings.fix: Add Kiro-specific lines to the next owner-decision round (Q20+): native tool-name table row, session-id source, keyless live path, and release/distribution channel. Until then these six items are open blockers, not settled.

findings.fix: Replace the KIRO_API_KEY cell with a local `kiro-cli login` session-token path, or mark Kiro live tests SKIPPED with a documented reason in ADR-0012, matching the other agents' rows.

findings.claim: Kiro's 'no MCP instructions channel' finding rests on kirodotdev/Kiro#11096 being open. Re-checked today (2026-10-14): the doc does not record a re-check date, so a future reviewer cannot tell if this [V] no is still current without re-querying GitHub, which is against the project's own 'GitHub issues/PRs are disabled, never call the API' evidence rule for this review.
findings.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:81 'kirodotdev/Kiro#11096 ... is still open (created 2026-08-27, label `mcp`)'. Task instructions for this review: 'GitHub issues/PRs are disabled, never call the API for them.'
findings.fix: Stamp the TECH-SPEC row with the verification date it already has as a convention elsewhere (e.g. 'as of 2026-06-25' used for Copilot CLI) so staleness is visible without an API call.

findings.claim: Cleanup rule for Kiro is still only 'Same rule as Claude Code' for `.hooks.*` flat entries, unchanged since r3. v1 also wrote a whole custom agent config.kiro/agent.json (named 'context-mode') and a KIRO.md steering doc; a cleanup pass following only the Claude Code rule leaves those two artifacts on disk after v1->v2 migration or uninstall.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 163023a4 2026-05-12 'chore(kiro): mirror external-MCP matcher in configs/kiro/agent.json' — commit message: 'so users who install via the configs template (rather than `context-mode upgrade`) also get the external-MCP routing protection'. This confirms the template-install path (agent.json, KIRO.md) is a real, separate v1 distribution channel, not a hypothetical.
findings.evidence: ADR-0011:68 '`~/.kiro/agents/default.json` `.hooks.*` flat entries ... | Same rule as Claude Code'. v1 configs/kiro/agent.json: '"name": "context-mode"'. v1 src/adapters/kiro/index.ts:43 'configs/kiro/KIRO.md. Users can copy it into `.kiro/steering/`'.
findings.fix: Add a Kiro-specific cleanup line: scan `~/.kiro/agents/*.json` for name == 'context-mode' and report (do not silently delete, per no-destructive-fallback norms); flag `.kiro/steering/KIRO.md` for manual review.
